label: Updated at 8 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: AIG Women's Open Major Trend
items.text: Eight of the top-10 players, including leader Yealimi Noh at 7-under, chase their first major title Sunday at Royal Lytham & St Annes with five players within three shots.

items.headline: Davis Riley Leads Last Rocket Mortgage
items.text: Davis Riley closes strong to take a 1-shot lead into the final round, aiming for his first PGA Tour win in over two years and a postseason bid.

items.headline: Woosnam's 2001 Open Penalty
items.text: Ian Woosnam received a two-stroke penalty for carrying 15 clubs in 2001, turning his opening birdie into a bogey and finishing four shots behind the leader, which derailed his major hopes.
